subject: Anthropic launches Personal Finance in Claude
intro: Anthropic introduced a Personal Finance feature in Claude allowing users to analyze spending data directly within the app. Google updated its model lineup with Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash for lower costs and longer multimodal context. Meanwhile, privacy disclosures highlighted that Google Gemini trains on chat history by default even for paid personal accounts.

items.title: Introducing Personal Finance in Claude
items.blurb: Anthropic launched a Personal Finance feature in Claude, enabling users to connect financial accounts and analyze personal spending data.

items.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
items.blurb: Google DeepMind released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, providing a faster and more cost-effective model with longer video and audio context capabilities.

items.title: Tell HN: Gemini trains on chat history, even for subscribers (personal accounts)
items.blurb: Users noted that Google Gemini uses chat history from personal subscriber accounts for model training by default.

items.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.blurb: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized model designed to detect software vulnerabilities and suggest patch fixes within authorized scope.

items.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
items.blurb: A security report revealed that Claude Code's auto-approval setting contributed to hardcoded passwords being committed to over 1,000 public GitHub repositories.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra
items.blurb: Cost-effective reasoning and general tasks at half the price of Sol. 'Terra Pro' = same model, pro reasoning mode.

items.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
items.blurb: Fast conversational video generation and editing.

items.title: heqiangdiao-wq/AI-Cross-Border-Ecommerce-Agent-Toolkit
items.blurb: A collection of standard prompts, templates, and Python scripts that turn cross-border e-commerce procedures into 7 reusable AI agent workflows. Heads-up: The included reference PDF contains raw internal SOP notes with illegal tactics like fake reviews, though the repository's 7 AI agent workflows filter these out to offer compliant alternatives.

items.title: caru-ini/stack-diagram
items.blurb: An agent skill that turns plain English descriptions of tech stacks into architecture diagrams with official logos. Heads-up: Requires Python 3.9+ and an internet connection to download logos, plus Playwright if exporting to PNG.

items.title: CSUNX233/qwen3.8-27b-ninfer-5070tilaptop-kvmem-local-agent
items.blurb: An optimized Windows inference engine and agent environment for running the 27B-parameter Qwen model on consumer 12GB graphics cards. Heads-up: Requires Windows, 32GB system RAM, and an NVIDIA RTX 30-series GPU or newer with at least 12GB VRAM. Certain included model variants use the Swift Open License with commercial revenue limitations.

items.title: karpathy/nanochat
items.blurb: A minimal, hackable experimental harness for training, evaluating, and chatting with custom language models on a single computer node. Heads-up: Requires powerful hardware such as multi-GPU (8xH100 or 8xA100) clusters with substantial VRAM (80GB) to train GPT-2 sized models effectively; running on CPU or laptops produces severely limited models.

items.title: modelflare-ai/AnyModelBot
items.blurb: A local desktop assistant that runs background tasks, handles files, and connects to messaging apps using pay-as-you-go models. Heads-up: Requires a Modelflare account and API balance for model access, meaning your model requests route through Modelflare's logging proxy.

items.title: max-sixty/worktrunk
items.blurb: A command-line tool that simplifies managing multiple Git folders simultaneously to keep AI agent tasks separated.

items.title: morluto/rea
items.blurb: Reverse engineer apps, binaries, and websites with AI agents.

items.title: pingdotgg/t3code
items.blurb: An open-source desktop, web, and mobile control surface that lets you remotely manage coding agents running on your machine.

items.title: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-Go
items.blurb: An Android client that runs DeepSeek Harness directly on your phone or remotely controls it running on your PC.

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.blurb: A coding-agent skill that coordinates multi-phase security audits with isolated hunting and independent verification.

items.title: zouyuxuan122/dsh-our-free-model
items.blurb: This is a free model plugin for dsh that adds frontier models like Muse Spark 1.3 and MiMo V2.6 with zero configuration, no sign-up, and no API keys required.

items.title: modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk
items.blurb: The official Python SDK for building Model Context Protocol servers and clients.

items.title: vercel/ai
items.blurb: The AI SDK is Vercel's free TypeScript library for adding AI to web apps. It gives one API across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, plus UI hooks for building chat interfaces in React, Next.js, Svelte and Vue.

items.title: huggingface/transformers
items.blurb: Hugging Face Transformers is an open-source Python library to download, run, and train state-of-the-art machine learning models for text, vision, and audio.
